description: Angular component for configuring time-series chart widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form handling, validation, and dynamic UI updates.

classes.name: TimeSeriesChartWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing the settings of a time-series chart widget, including form controls, validation, and dynamic configuration based on widget type parameters.

methods.name: datasource
methods.description: Getter that returns the first datasource from widget configuration or null if none exist.

methods.name: yAxisIds
methods.description: Getter that returns the list of y-axis IDs from the form's yAxes control.

methods.name: yAxisRemoved
methods.description: Removes references to a y-axis ID from all data keys in datasources except the first.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget settings.

methods.name: onWidgetConfigSet
methods.description: Sets the chart type based on widget configuration parameters and updates form controls accordingly.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided settings and adds/removes controls based on chart type.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form values to ensure valid configuration.

methods.name: _tooltipValuePreviewFn
methods.description: Returns a sample formatted tooltip value.

methods.name: _tooltipDatePreviewFn
methods.description: Returns a formatted date string based on current tooltip date format settings.
